item.title: Two new measles cases confirmed in Montana
item.description: Press release Dec. 2, 2025 The Department of Public Health and Human Services (DPHHS) is reporting two new measles cases in Gallatin County. The new cases may have exposed the public to measles in multiple locations in Gallatin and Missoula Counties in November. One case was confirmed on Nov. 28, and the most recent case on Dec. 1.
